description: Fetch the citable World Arena snapshot (/facts/world-arena.json). Use this for numbers; do not invent market scores. Default section=summary (a few KB: stats, facts, asset pages, citation passages, list of sections with sizes). Pass section=<name> for one section (e.g. rankings, assets, arena_verified_registry); the full file stays at url.
name: get_world_arena_facts
